events.title: Supreme Court issues Callais v. Louisiana decision gutting Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act
events.summary: In Callais v. Louisiana, the Supreme Court majority, led by Justice Samuel Alito, issued a ruling that effectively neutralizes Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act by imposing new requirements on plaintiffs challenging racially discriminatory voting maps. The decision requires minority voters to prove discriminatory intent rather than discriminatory effect, and to provide alternative maps that maintain the original partisan goals—standards that legal experts say render Section 2 unenforceable in practice.
